question: Will the Cleveland Guardians win the 2026 World Series?
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve according to the team that wins the 2026 MLB World Series. 

If at any point it becomes impossible for a listed team to win the 2026 MLB World Series per the rules of MLB (e.g., they are eliminated in the playoffs), the corresponding market will resolve to “No”.

If the 2026 MLB season is cancelled, postponed after December 31, 2026 ET, or there is otherwise no winner declared within that timeframe, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source will be official information from MLB (https://www.mlb.com/); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
research:
I couldn't open MLB.com or Polymarket directly, so the status below comes from news coverage. As of the cutoff, the Guardians had not won or been knocked out. They led the ALCS 2-1 over the Tampa Bay Rays, and the Milwaukee Brewers were waiting in the World Series. I left out several search results dated after 2026-10-17.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on official MLB information (mlb.com). I didn't fetch it. Going by the news coverage below, MLB had not named a 2026 champion as of 2026-10-17.

## 2. Current status
- 2026-10-15: Cleveland beat Tampa Bay 3-2 in ALCS Game 3 and took a 2-1 series lead. Petey Halpin hit a go-ahead two-run homer, Gavin Williams struck out nine over five innings, and Cade Smith got the final four outs. [Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/2026/10/15/sports/guardians-rays-alcs-game-3-score/), [theScore](https://www.thescore.com/mlb/news/3615968)
- Earlier games: Cleveland won Game 1 7-3, and the Rays won Game 2 3-1 behind Freddy Peralta. [FOX 13](https://www.fox13news.com/sports/rays-vs-guardians-cleveland-claims-game-3-victory-alcs)
- 2026-10-16: Game 4 was set for Friday at Progressive Field with rain in the forecast. Reports say it was rained out and moved to Saturday, 2026-10-17. If that holds, a Game 5 would follow there and a Game 6 would move to Tropicana Field.
- 2026-10-15: The Brewers swept the two-time defending champion Dodgers 4-0 in the NLCS. Game 4 ended 6-4, and it is Milwaukee's first pennant since 1982. World Series Game 1 is set for Friday, 2026-10-23, in Milwaukee. [WDBJ7/AP](https://www.wdbj7.com/2026/10/16/brewers-sweep-dodgers-nlcs-reach-world-series-first-time-since-1982/?outputType=amp)
- To win the title, Cleveland needs two more ALCS wins and then four World Series wins against Milwaukee.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- About 2026-10-16: SI ran a headline saying the Brewers were now World Series favorites and the Guardians were favored over the Rays in the AL. I couldn't open the page. [SI](https://www.si.com/betting/2026-world-series-odds-brewers-jump-to-favorite-guardians-favored-over-rays-in-al)
- 2026-10-15: Guardians won Game 3. Brewers finished the NLCS sweep (sources above).
- Earlier in October: Cleveland won the AL Central and came back from 0-2 to beat the White Sox in a five-game ALDS. One search summary mentioned this, but I couldn't confirm the date.

## 4. Base rates
- I didn't find a published 2026 figure. Historically, teams leading a best-of-seven series 2-1 have won the series roughly two-thirds of the time. That's from my general knowledge, not a source I checked.
- The pennant winner then plays a World Series. Before game-level adjustments, that is roughly a 45-50% chance for either side. Here the Brewers would be the betting favorite and would have home-field advantage, since Game 1 is in Milwaukee.
- Recent champions: Dodgers in 2024 and 2025. Cleveland hasn't won since 1948.

## 5. Other forecasts
- One FanDuel listing, written before the ALCS ended, had the Brewers at -190, the Guardians at +340 (about 23% implied, before removing the bookmaker's margin) and the Rays at +540. I couldn't confirm its exact date. It seems to match the Guardians-up-2-1 period, but that is my inference. [SI / search summary](https://www.si.com/betting/2026-world-series-odds-brewers-jump-to-favorite-guardians-favored-over-rays-in-al)
- Earlier BetMGM playoff preview: Dodgers +210, Brewers +550, Rays +800, Guardians +1200. [SI](https://www.si.com/betting/2026-world-series-odds-for-every-team-ahead-of-alds-nlds-matchups-dodgers-yankees-and-brewers-top-odds-list-01m3yd7kezar)
- Polymarket: the only Guardians World Series snapshot I found was from late May 2026 (4¢), so it's out of date. [simplefunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/markets/mlb-world-series-champion-2026-cleveland-guardians-polymarket-0x67a229c77a)
- I found no current Kalshi or Manifold prices.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-10-17 onward: ALCS Game 4 at Cleveland, after the rainout. If needed, Game 5 at Cleveland, Games 6-7 at Tampa Bay.
- 2026-10-23: World Series Game 1 in Milwaukee.
- The question's stated resolution date (about 2026-10-20) is before the World Series even starts. A "No" can only come early if Cleveland is eliminated in the ALCS. A "Yes" would have to wait until the World Series ends, around late October or early November.
